        return 0
    
    max_prod = min_prod = result = nums[0]
    
    for i in range(1, len(nums)):
        num = nums[i]
        
        # Calculate potential products before updating current values
        temp_max = max(num, max_prod * num)
        temp_min = min(num, min_prod * num)
        
        # Update current max and min product ending at this position
        max_prod = temp_max

        # Update global result if needed
